text:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: PROD ALERT — abnormal spike in 5xx + TIMEOUTS observed after rolling canary for `inference-proxy v2.7.0`. p95 and p99 exploded, alerting our latency probe. root ts=3112003456

Maya R.: Noted. I see p95 jumped from ~400ms -> ~3.2s and p99 ~14s. Canary was at 15% traffic. Deploy metadata: user=omar, image=inference-proxy:v2.7.0.

DeployBot: Deploy finished by @omar at 3112003300 — canary=15% -> scheduled rollout.

Omar T.: Rolling canary included a change to connection pooling + keepalive backoff. I pushed the change to reduce backend idle connections; maybe aggressive.

Anika P.: pulling logs from canary hosts. Repeated errors: `gateway: upstream read timeout`, `connection reset by peer` and a stack showing grpc dial timeout. sample:```ERROR rpc_client.go:88 upstream read timeout: context deadline exceeded```

SRE Night: Initial hypothesis: connection pool shrink + keepalive backoff caused backend kv/proxy to drop idle connections -> instant cold reconnect storms -> connection queue saturation -> timeouts. Agree that immediate traffic rollback is safest.

Maya R.: Can we pause the rollout and route 100% to previous variant? If we shift traffic now we should see improvement quickly.

DeployBot: Manual control available:```redwoodctl traffic set --service inference-proxy --to v2.6.4 --percent 100```

Omar T.: Executing the traffic set now.

Omar T.: Command output:```shifting traffic: OK
new split: v2.6.4=100%```

Oncall Bot: :white_check_mark: Traffic shifted to v2.6.4. Starting rollback procedures.

Anika P.: Metrics: p95 fell from 3.2s -> 550ms within 45s of shift. p99 coming down toward 900ms. Error rate back to baseline but tail still noisy. Link: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/latency/inference?from=now-10m

Toby J. (Support): Notifying customers about degraded requests during the window. Early estimate: ~9% global error rate spike, concentrated in EU region for ~4 minutes. I'll prep canned message and escalate to CSMs.

Maya R.: I'll pin the current artifact and block any automated rollouts:```redwoodctl artifact lock inference-proxy:v2.7.0 --block``` Also create rollback record.

DeployBot: Artifact v2.7.0 locked by Maya R. — automation blocked.

SRE Night: Collecting flamegraphs and tcp dumps from canary hosts, storing in /artifacts/incidents/3112003456/. Captured tcpdump showing SYN/ACK drops during reconnect storm.

Anika P.: Also archived application logs and sampled traces. Tarball: s3://redwood-incidents/3112003456-archive.tar.gz

Omar T.: I'll open a changelist revert and push a patch to revert the keepalive backoff and add a canary guard for connection failures.

Maya R.: Assigning follow-ups: engineering to revert + add unit/integration tests around pool resizing, SRE to add canary monitoring rule: abort canary if p99>3s for 2m or 5xx rate > 2x baseline. Support to finalize customer communication and legal to review SLA exposure.

Toby J.: Will send an initial customer note within 30m. Suggest offering request logs / credits for impacted customers.

Legal: We'll review SLA thresholds; please route any customers asking for formal incident impact to legal@redwood.

Oncall Bot: Incident marked mitigated -> monitoring. Keeping page open for 60m watch. Postmortem ticket created: INC-3112003456.

Maya R.: Handing over to SRE Night for watch and RCA coordination. @Omar T. will own the rollback/revert and postmortem writeup. Preliminary RCA ETA 3 hours.

Omar T.: I'll include timeline, diff, and traces showing connection churn. Also adding a post-deploy checklist item to run short tail-latency smoke on canary traffic.

Maya R.: Thanks team. Quick note: add an automatic artifact-stage guard so artifacts that change pool/persistent-connection configs require an extended canary and an explicit override to proceed. :thumbsup:

SRE Night: Acknowledged. Monitoring rules to be implemented in next runbook sprint.

Oncall Bot: Paging cleared. Thread remains open until postmortem is published.
